description:
Gate status reports a recorded manual attestation as never run.

## Background

After a manual gate is attested, the latest-run view of gate status for that gate says the gate has not been run and suggests evaluating it, while the readiness view counts it as passed. A lead must use the readiness view to see manual gates.

Reproduction in a fresh repository: define a manual gate `review`, create and claim an issue requiring it, attest it with `--by human:me`, then request gate status for `review`. Output: `Gate 'review' has not been run yet for issue <id>. Use 'jit gate evaluate' to run it.`

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The latest-run view of gate status shows a recorded manual attestation with its attestor and time.
- [hard] REQ-02: The history view lists manual attestations alongside automated runs.
- [hard] REQ-03: The latest-run and readiness views agree on every gate's status.
title: Gate status reports a manual attestation as never run
